scope: Independent read-only source review and inert Node harness; not actual browser/physical qualification

findings.issue: Home flushes untouched fallback draft, initializing/saving new workspace after read-only readiness/diagnostics visit. Shared setup.js startup marks fallback dirty=1.
findings.reproduction: Actual flush and Home handler executed in inert Node VM with untouched uninitialized default draft; calls initialize, save, navigate:/. No real service/files/physical transport invoked.
findings.recommended: Track untouched provisional template separately; guard and flush genuine edits only. Automatic setup route must not silently initialize fallback.

findings.issue: Promise.all error clears timeout without aborting sibling fetch; repeat refresh can accumulate pending read requests.
findings.recommended: Abort the controller on completion/failure before clearing timeout.

findings.issue: Initial-view observer disconnects after15s without notice; late startup shows default wizard despite requested route.
findings.recommended: Preserve pending requested route or show explicit retry notice.

positive_source_findings: Shell inherits exact base Host/token/Origin checks; extra assets use exact Host allowlist and inherited security response headers.
CSP remains same-origin, frame-ancestors none, no inline scripts; shell renders service strings with textContent.
Read-only shell GET endpoints delegate shared service; no new motion/AI/write APIs added.
Before status paint, binding matches store_id/epoch/revision/generation/active hash/draft hash; authority guards remain false/inhibited.
